headline: Student Powers School with 16-Panel Solar Project
meta_description: A Grade 12 student in New Brunswick raised $35,000 and built a 16-panel solar installation that now fully powers his school's athletic facility.
summary_short: A New Brunswick high school student led a solar energy project that transformed his school's power supply—and proved young people can drive real change.
body:
A Grade 12 student in New Brunswick spearheaded a solar energy project that now fully powers his school's athletic facility, after raising $35,000 and overseeing the installation of 16 solar panels.

The student's initiative demonstrates how youth-led environmental projects can deliver tangible results at the community level. By securing substantial funding and managing a technical installation, he transformed a vision for renewable energy into working infrastructure that serves his school daily.

The completed 16-panel system represents both a practical energy solution and a model for what student leadership can accomplish—proving that age is no barrier to tackling the infrastructure challenges of our time.
